                      MESSAGE OF THE HON’BLE VICE-CHANCELLOR




      It is a profound pleasure to welcome you all to Dr. Shakuntala Misra National Rehabilitation
University, located in the capital of Uttar Pradesh, Lucknow. Our institution aims to empower the
marginalized section of the society by offering an excellent academic environment through inclusive
education. Here, diversity, inclusivity and academic excellence converge to build an educational
experience that is truly transformative. We hold a steadfast belief that every individual is endowed with
unique talents, abilities and aptitudes, irrespective of their physical capabilities. Education and
opportunities for learning must be accessible to all, transcending socio-economic and physical barriers.
To this end, our University is committed to dismantling every obstacle to learning, empowering all
students, including Divyangjan, to realize their fullest potential. We are resolute in ensuring that financial
constraints do not impede the pursuit of knowledge and skill acquisition for any individual. Our University
offers unparalleled academic and infrastructural resources, state-of-the-art assistive technologies,
comprehensive sports facilities, and a range of support services designed to foster excellence among our

compassionate and developed nation. Our efforts in fostering a barrier-free environment were recognized
and honoured with the National Award in 2014 by the former President of India, the Honorable Shri
Pranab Mukherjee.

programs to deliver value-based education, thereby advancing our objectives of socio-economic and
technological development to global standards. Our commitment extends to the rehabilitation of Divyang
individuals, exemplified by our Artificial Limb & Rehabilitation Center, which provides free-of-cost artificial
limbs to differently-abled individuals, irrespective of their geographical location. Additionally, our
University is equipped with a Braille Press and a Talking-book Studio for visually impaired students, along
with Sign Language interpreters for an inclusive classroom experience for hearing impaired students,
ensuring equitable access to learning resources for all. Our institution offers its hostel and mess services
free of cost, in addition to zero tuition fees for Divyang students.
      We eagerly anticipate your joining our vibrant academic community, contributing to the elevation of
our University to new heights, and aiding in our collective pursuit of knowledge, growth, and social
development. Rest assured, DSMNRU will serve as an exceptional platform for your academic and holistic
development. Together, let us create a future where all individuals, regardless of physical constraints, can
achieve success and thrive to their utmost potential.
